name: Suno Speech
summary: Create spoken stories, poems, or pep talks with original background music in one track. Describe the voice and musical style you want, then try the public beta on web or mobile.

name: MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming
summary: Add live captions, dictation, or voice controls to your app in 60 languages, with text arriving as people speak. Available now through Microsoft Foundry and Vercel at an introductory $0.54 per audio hour through December.

name: Strands Decider 2B
summary: Sort customer messages, choose the next tool for an AI assistant, or score its answers without paying for every API call. This free, open-source model runs locally on Macs and PCs, with code and training materials included.

name: invideo MCP
summary: Ask Claude, Codex, or Cursor to cut footage, mix audio, and generate clips on a video timeline you can edit yourself. Manual editing is free, while AI generation uses credits and assistant plan requirements apply.

name: Dots
summary: Put an always-on agent to work across connected apps to draft content, investigate feedback, and prepare work for review. It has its own cloud computer and is rolling out to Pro users in eligible markets.

name: GPT-6.1 Sol
summary: Build coding and computer-use agents with near-Astra capability at $2 input and $10 output per million tokens. It is available now in the API, Codex, and ChatGPT Work for paid plans.

name: Claude Sonnet 5.5
summary: Build apps, fix bugs, and produce polished documents with a faster everyday model. It is live in Claude and the API at $2 input and $10 output per million tokens, and typically uses fewer tokens per task than Sonnet 5.

name: Holo4 35B-A3B
summary: Build agents that operate apps through screenshots, code, APIs, and MCP tools. Apache-licensed weights and 4-bit downloads are available now, along with a hosted API priced at $0.30 input and $2 output per million tokens.
